text: でんじは　って　べんり　なのに

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', and ending on it shows disappointment about what happened. べんり　なのに = 'even though it's so handy...'

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way of saying 'as for this thing'. でんじは　って = 'Thunder Wave, well, it'.
